arxiv:2608.26067.title: StreamPI: Streaming Multimodal Temporal Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models

arxiv:2608.26105.title: VBVR-Pro: A Scalable and Verifiable Suite for Native Visual Reasoning

arxiv:2608.26809.title: Thinking on Shots: Consistent Multi-Shot Video Editing with Agentic Reasoning
